rationale: The agent did not adhere to key policy requirements. While it looked up the user and orders, there is no evidence of authenticating the user. It performed order-changing writes (two modify_pending_order_items calls) without first confirming with the user. It also failed to follow the user’s conditional instructions: no attempt to cancel if unshipped was shown, no confirmation that the replacement was the cheapest possible air purifier, and no refund-to-gift-card handling (it used a credit card as payment method). The agent did not provide shipping status or ETA, and the final user-facing message was a generic closing that did not address or confirm any actions. These issues violate the pass criteria and policy, so the outcome fails.
